claims.scope: For every Boolean outer gate and pairwise-disjoint balanced Boolean children, U(g(h))=U(g)+sum_j Inf_j(g)U(h_j), and I(g(h))=sum_j Inf_j(g)I(h_j).
claims.quantifiers: All finite arities, dimensions, and genuine Boolean outer and inner functions satisfying pairwise disjointness and zero child means.

claims.scope: For F=g(P_1,...,P_m) with nonempty disjoint parity blocks of sizes d_j, U(F)=U(g), I(F)=sum_j d_j Inf_j(g), and G(F)=sum_{j:d_j=1} Delta_j U(g).
claims.quantifiers: Every finite arity, every genuine Boolean outer gate, and all positive integer block sizes.
claims.new_bound: If all d_j>=2, G(F)=0, giving the sharp class constant K=0 independent of dimension, arity, width, and flattened parity depth.

claims.candidate_refuted: Coordinatewise nonnegativity Delta_i U>=0, and the resulting monotonicity of G under parity inflation.
claims.witness: Three-bit truth vector (+,+,-,+,+,-,-,-) has Delta U=(1/2,-1/2,-1/2) and G=-1/2; widths (1,2,2) give G=1/2.
claims.scope_limit: This does not refute the upper bound G<=K I, universal GU, or FEI.

claims.scope: Pay the complete biased upper-mass composition defect after physical restriction of a generic balanced child.
claims.unpaid_step: Derive a signed biased-child defect identity and pay its coherent remainder with one source-influence or terminal-reserve ledger across adaptive restrictions.
